hook: Pacifica Hill Crest fire hits *floors 5 to 14*, no casualties
hook_b: Pacifica Hill Crest fire hits *floors 5 to 14*, no casualties
tldr: A fire broke out on Thursday afternoon in one tower of the Pacifica Hill Crest apartment complex at Puppalaguda, Nanakramguda, near the Financial District. Fire tenders from several stations responded and residents evacuated. Fire officials reported no casualties and no major property loss.

beats.what: Fire hit one tower of the Pacifica Hill Crest apartments in Puppalaguda on Thursday afternoon, affecting the 5th to 14th floors.
beats.why: Fire tenders from different stations were sent after the call; residents rushed out of the building.
beats.care: Residents of high-rises near the Financial District: officials have not yet said what caused it.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 19): a fire official said there was no major loss of property or casualties; the cause is being ascertained.
